trophies.guide: The platinum is the finish line, not a task of its own: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to hunt here directly. Follow the roadmap in order — story, strangers, activities, collectibles, heists, then the stage 6 cleanup — and check the tracker after each stage to see what is left. PowerPyx orders its roadmap the same six stages.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the Gone Fishing story mission and see it through to its ending cutscene. It is a main-story beat, so you cannot miss it by doing side content first: keep following the story missions and it unlocks on its own. If it has not popped, you have simply not reached that mission yet. GTABase lists it among the opening story trophies.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1, including the chapter's closing mission, and the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Story chapters unlock in order, so there is no way to skip ahead or miss it: just keep playing the main missions and do not worry about side activities until the chapter is done. GTABase counts it as the first chapter-complete trophy.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2 through its final mission and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable: the story only moves forward, so keep taking the next main mission and it will come. Use the chapter break to tidy up any stage 1 activities nearby before moving on. PowerPyx and GTABase both place it in the story's second chapter.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Clear all of Chapter 3's story missions, including its finale, and this pops as the chapter closes. It is unmissable and story-gated, so the only requirement is time in the main missions. By this point the map is well opened up, so it is a good moment to try the meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude while you travel between missions. GTABase lists it with the other chapter trophies.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4's story missions to the end and the trophy unlocks with the chapter. Nothing here can be missed: every chapter trophy is awarded for reaching the end of its chapter, whatever order you did side content in. If you are saving collectibles for later, this is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so the story is nearly done. PowerPyx lists it as the fourth chapter-complete trophy.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the game's final story mission and watch the credits roll; the gold trophy pops at the end. This is the story's endpoint, so it is unmissable, but it also unlocks the post-game state where most cleanup trophies become far easier — the map stays open, so do not rush into stage 6 without first noting which side content is still undone. PowerPyx marks it as the story's closing trophy.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Play the Breakfast Run story mission to its conclusion. It is a named mission inside the story, so it unlocks as you follow the main path and cannot be missed by exploring first. If you are unsure whether you have done it, the tracker in this guide lists it under the story stage — it will be checked once the mission's end cutscene plays. GTABase lists it among the named story missions.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist story mission from its setup to its getaway. Heist missions tend to be longer than ordinary ones, with a planning beat first, so follow each objective marker in turn and do not leave the mission area mid-way. The trophy pops when the heist's closing scene plays. PowerPyx counts it as one of the story's big set-piece missions.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Play the Child's Play story mission through to its end. It is a named mission on the main path, so it cannot be missed and needs no special approach: take the mission when it appears and follow its objectives to the closing scene. If the trophy has not popped, the mission is still ahead of you in the story. PowerPyx lists it with the other named story missions.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners story mission from start to finish. It is one of the named missions in the story's middle stretch, so it unlocks by following the main missions in order. There is no optional objective to worry about: finishing the mission is the whole requirement. GTABase places it among the story's named missions.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown story mission, which takes place around Vice City International Airport. It is a main-story mission, so it unlocks in order and cannot be missed. Expect a combat-heavy stretch with airport security and armed opposition — bring a stocked weapon loadout and armour before you start, and follow the objective markers through the takedown. PowerPyx lists it as a story mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory story mission to its end. It is a late-story operation with a military flavour, so it is one of the longer missions — set aside time, stock up on ammo and armour, and work through its objectives in order. The trophy pops when the operation's final scene plays. GTABase counts it among the named story missions.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the game's checklist, which counts story missions, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the other tracked totals — not just the trophy list. This is the long grind of the platinum and it belongs at the very end of the roadmap: finish everything else first, then use the in-game completion screen to find the last few percent. PowerPyx and Exophase both treat it as the final gold before the platinum.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the total, and the counter keeps a running tally. The fastest way is to chain them on open roads and ramps: use a fast bike or sports car, hit jumps at speed, and keep moving rather than stopping between attempts. KeenGamer and TrueTrophies both note it is a pure grind, best done while travelling between other objectives.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type in the game once: races, fishing, the shooting range, drone races, the arcade, hunting, bowling and the rest. You do not need to win or master any of them — one attempt each is enough. Work through the activities list in this guide during stage 3 and tick each off as you try it; the trophy pops when the last type is sampled. PowerPyx lists it as the activities sampler.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Each challenge scores accuracy, speed and target hits, so take them one at a time and learn the target pattern before pushing for gold: use a steady weapon with a good sight, control your breathing on long shots, and restart a challenge the moment a run goes bad rather than finishing a low score. KeenGamer and TrueTrophies both flag the range as one of the harder skill trophies.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of its locations around Leonida. Drone races are about clean lines and throttle control: cut corners tight, avoid clipping gates, and learn each course's layout on a practice run before racing for the win. You must win at every location, not just one, so work through them in turn and note which are done. PowerPyx and TrueTrophies list the race locations.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida's race types — street, off-road, water and air events all count, but each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct events. Enter races from their start points, pick a vehicle suited to the terrain, and keep a clean line; winning is what matters, not the margin. KeenGamer and Exophase note that variety is the requirement, not repeats of one easy race.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: you and Cal fish the same spot and the bigger catch wins, so use the best rod and bait you have and watch the line tension — reel steadily, ease off when the fish runs, and do not let the line snap. If Cal wins, challenge him again; the trophy only needs one win. PowerPyx and GTABase both name Cal as the fishing rival.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play an arcade game in one of Leonida's arcades and complete it — reach its end or clear its final level, depending on the cabinet. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you find easiest and learn its controls first; most are short, so a single focused session is enough. PowerPyx and Exophase note that simply starting one is not enough — you must finish it.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you explore Leonida and meet their characters, so find Andy, work through each of his missions in order, and the trophy pops when his last one ends. Strands are easy to miss if you never wander off the main path, so check the map for stranger markers between story missions. PowerPyx and GTABase list Andy's strand.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's stranger mission strand to its final mission. Like the other stranger strands, it appears as a marker on the map once you have met Kenton — follow his missions one by one and the trophy unlocks at the end of the last. If his marker has not appeared yet, keep playing the story and exploring; stranger strands open up as the game progresses. PowerPyx and GTABase both cover Kenton's missions.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's stranger mission strand through its final mission. Meet Billy at his map marker, play each of his missions in order, and the trophy pops when his strand concludes. Billy's missions are on the wilder side, so bring a vehicle you do not mind damaging and expect chases. PowerPyx and GTABase list his strand with the other strangers.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands across Leonida. There are more than eight strangers in the state, so you do not need every one — pick eight whose markers you find and finish each strand to its last mission. The strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them; find three more by exploring and following stranger markers. PowerPyx and PSNProfiles both count eight completed strands for this silver.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's stranger mission strand to its final mission. Find Randy's marker, work through his missions in order, and the trophy unlocks when his last mission ends. Randy's strand is one of the eight that count toward Strangers & Freaks, so finishing it helps two trophies at once. PowerPyx and GTABase both list Randy's missions.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's stranger mission strand through its final mission. Meet Tyrone, play his missions in order, and the trophy pops at the end of his last one. Like the other stranger strands it is unmissable once started — the only way to miss it is to never find his marker, so sweep the map for stranger icons while you do stage 2. PowerPyx and GTABase cover Tyrone's strand.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. This is the game's only missable trophy, so do it during stage 1, while you are still travelling between story missions: visit each spot, sit and meditate, and tick it off in this guide before you move on. Spots are spread across the whole state, including remote ones, so do not leave them all for the post-game — a spot tied to a story area can become unreachable later. PowerPyx and GTABase list the spot locations.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt targets one specific animal, so find its habitat — unique animals roam particular areas of Leonida — track it quietly, and take the shot when you have a clean line. Bring a scoped rifle and approach from downwind; if the animal flees, leave the area and return rather than chasing it across the map. KeenGamer and GTABase both name Bret's hunt.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete three full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden around Leonida — in shops, interiors and out-of-the-way spots — and each set needs every card in it, so you must collect them all, not just most. Work one set at a time and use the tracker to note which cards are still missing; cards do not respawn, so a careful sweep beats a rushed one. PowerPyx and Exophase both map the card locations.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 different locations across Leonida. The WAiNK spots are scattered through the state — towns, landmarks, viewpoints and odd corners — and each one only counts once, so you need breadth, not repeats. Fold them into your travel: whenever you pass a new area, check for a WAiNK spot before moving on. PowerPyx and Exophase both list the spot locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and activities, and each one is a small goal with a clear condition — finish 50 of them in any combination. Check the challenge menu regularly and pick off the easy ones first; the count keeps rising as you play normally, so this is mostly a matter of breadth. PowerPyx and TrueTrophies both note that any 50 will do.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then lose the cops and escape. Get the heat up together — cause chaos until four stars show — then break line of sight, switch vehicles, and hide until the wanted level clears. Doing it with your partner is the requirement, so do not send them away first; escape together. KeenGamer and Exophase both describe it as a partner escape.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole way. Plan a route through three nearby shops, hit each one quickly, and keep moving — lingering lets the cops close in, and losing the wanted level breaks the chain. A fast getaway car parked close to the third shop makes the escape far easier. PowerPyx and TrueTrophies both stress the back-to-back chain.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. Every vehicle type counts once — cars, bikes, boats, planes and more — so variety matters: drive anything you have not seen before, and check the discovery list to see what is still missing. Rare vehicles hide in specific places, so a sweep of dealerships, docks and airfields helps. PowerPyx and Exophase both list the vehicle types.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a group of five or more enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and work through them fast — the slowdown is short, so line up your shots before you activate it and prioritise the nearest targets. A crowded shootout or a gang hideout is the best place to try. KeenGamer and TrueTrophies both note it needs five in one activation.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — take a plane and leave without following the usual departure. Get to the airfield, board an aircraft, and take off from the runway without waiting for clearance or a scheduled slot. Airport security will object, so be quick on the throttle and climb fast once you are airborne. PowerPyx and GTABase both describe the VCIA departure.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get behind the wheel of a Rhino tank and enjoy the ride — the trophy is about taking the tank out and using it. Rhinos are military hardware, so expect a fight to get one: military bases and convoys are the places to look, and once you are in, the wanted level will climb fast, so make the most of it while you have it. PowerPyx and GTABase both note the Rhino is the requirement.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Plan it like a quiet job: case the store first, learn the guard patrols and camera angles, strike when the floor is clear, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. Stealth is the whole requirement — if a guard spots you or the alarm trips, leave and try again. PowerPyx and TrueTrophies both stress staying undetected throughout.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is a full job — get in, crack the vault, grab the cash and get out clean — so plan your escape route before you go in, and do not linger once the money is in hand. Five separate vaults are needed, so work through them one at a time and tick each off. PowerPyx and GTABase both list the vault locations.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — spot one, stop it, crack it open and take the cash, then lose the cops. A heavy vehicle or a well-placed block works to stop it; once the money is yours, switch to a fast car and break line of sight. KeenGamer and Exophase both describe the truck robbery.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida — the whole state, from Vice City to the swamps and the Keys. The map fills in as you travel, so the requirement is coverage: drive, fly and sail into every corner until no fog remains. It pairs naturally with the other exploration trophies, so do it while hunting WAiNK spots and vehicles. PowerPyx and Exophase both treat it as full-map coverage.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Every gang runs its own off-the-books operations, so you need to hit one per gang — find their operations, rob them, and move on to the next gang's. Gangs are spread across the state, so this is a tour of Leonida's underworld as much as a robbery list. PowerPyx and GTABase both list the gangs and their operations.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar along Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and take in the view — this is one of the game's quiet moment trophies, with no combat or chase attached. It is a small scene, so the only requirement is finding the right spot and letting the moment play out. PowerPyx and PSNProfiles both place it on Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side. Pick a showroom with a clear run-up, build speed, and aim for the glass frontage; the trophy is about the exit, so commit to it and do not brake. PowerPyx and GTABase both describe the showroom smash.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — play a full game there and see it to its end. Bowling is a simple timing game: line up the shot, judge the power, and follow through cleanly. You do not need a perfect score, just a completed game at that specific alley. KeenGamer and Exophase both name the Kolt & Associates alley.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal — this is a story-adjacent trophy tied to how your partnership with Lucia or Jason plays out across the game. It unlocks through the story's relationship beats, so keep playing the main missions and making the partnership choices the story offers. There is no single action to perform: it comes from the arc itself. PowerPyx and PSNProfiles both tie it to the partnership story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make the choices the story puts in front of you and live with them. This trophy is tied to a decision point in the story — pick a side, follow it through, and the trophy pops when the consequences play out. There is no right answer, only a made one, so do not reload to second-guess it. PowerPyx and PSNProfiles both place it at a story choice.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Come back and try again — this trophy is about a second attempt succeeding where the first did not. It is tied to a story moment that can go wrong the first time, so if your first try fails, retry it rather than moving on: the second attempt is the one that counts. PowerPyx and PSNProfiles both describe it as a retry trophy.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Stumble into something strange and see it through — this trophy is tied to one of the game's odd, unexpected moments, the kind you find by exploring rather than following markers. Keep an eye out for the unusual while you travel Leonida, and when something weird happens, follow it to its end instead of walking past. PowerPyx and PSNProfiles both flag it as a surprise moment.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle using a melee weapon and knock them down. Get a vehicle moving at a good pace, pull alongside your targets, and swing as you pass; the trophy needs the drive-by to land, so pick a straight stretch with a few enemies on foot. KeenGamer and Exophase both describe the melee drive-by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts will clean them for a cut — hand the bills over, take the clean cash, and repeat until the total hits $250,000. It is a slow earner, so keep laundering after every big job rather than saving it for the end. PowerPyx and TrueTrophies both explain the laundering loop.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Every purchase counts — clothes, weapons, food, car mods, anything with a price tag — so just keep buying what you need as you play and the total climbs. If you are close at the end, big-ticket items like vehicles and weapon upgrades close the gap fast. PowerPyx and Exophase both count all shop spending toward it.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property available in Leonida. Garages go on sale as you progress and earn money, so check property listings regularly and buy each one as it appears — they are also useful for storing the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good. The trophy pops when the last garage is yours. PowerPyx and Exophase both list the garage properties.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, open the Scooter Bros app, and register each one — ten different registrations are needed, so keep an eye out for new rides as you travel. It pairs well with discovering vehicles for Whip It Good, since every new vehicle can be registered too. PowerPyx and TrueTrophies both explain the registration step.
trophies.name: On the Spot
